turbō, turbinis m.

noun, third declension

whirlwind, tornado

A wind that spins round on one spot (Seneca’s definition, NQ 5.13.3); Morgan–Owens adds terrēnus for a tornado over land. The same word is the spinning top.

Other words

  • vertex, verticis m. — a whirl of wind

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Lucr. 1.293; Liv. 21.58.3 (Lewis & Short)

    An eddy of wind or flame; chiefly a whirlpool (see whirlpool).

See also wind, storm, spinning top, whirlpool.
